versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the all-green skill.
- Automates the end-to-end workflow for preparing, publishing, and monitoring a GitHub pull request until all actionable review feedback is addressed and required checks are green.
- Runs a pre-publish review gate, presents findings for user approval, and only applies user-approved fixes before publication.
- Publishes changes, opens or updates a PR, and collects relevant PR metadata.
- Monitors GitHub review threads and CI checks, implements fixes locally, and repeats the process as needed.
- Obeys strict safety rules and requires explicit user approval for significant actions throughout the workflow.
